title: Bound bounded transient GitHub reads and isolate per-PR watchdog failures
root_cause: Source inspection: the current five-minute Required Gate Watchdog uses unbounded fetch and uncaught per-PR GitHub API errors; one slow/transient response can abort the remaining PR loop. Provider production recurrence has not been independently measured.
impact: A single provider failure can block other existing PR gate observations and same-owner repair signals.
failed_approaches: Treat missing provider response as a completed outcome
fix: Bound GitHub GET requests to 8 seconds and two transient-only attempts, isolate three PR failures per tick while returning nonzero on partial failures; never retry ambiguous POST.
prevention_rule: Use bounded GET-only retries, per-PR isolation, strict 403/404 denial, next-tick idempotent marker readback for ambiguous writes, and preserve exact-head Required/CodeQL plus protected merge.
outcome: CANDIDATE_UNVERIFIED; requires exact-head CI, protected merge and next watchdog runtime readback.
